authority: DESIGN_S7_run8.md 12-0-A-3 (AUC maximisation is forbidden) / 12-0-C (epsilon comes from measurement-side properties only)

prohibition.rule: Separation performance between break/ok labels must never enter candidate selection. B-1 receives no label input at all.
prohibition.machine_check: s7_b1_calibration.py::select_candidates accepts calibration measurements only; the harness asserts that no listening label / production cell is reachable from its inputs.

hard_requirements.definition: Two in-process repeats of the same stimulus under the same candidate produce identical values.
|value(gain_x100) - value(gain_x050)| for the same material at 1.0 and 0.5 linear gain (-6.02 dB).

|value(zero_buffer)|, where zero_buffer is a synthetic waveform whose samples are bit-exact 0.0, at the same sample rate and length as the other stimuli of the same calibration source. It measures whether the DETECTOR reports voicing / tail energy when nothing at all is present at its input.
hard_requirements.why_renamed: The old id was operationalised on the real-render source as rr_silence (an SP-only render), which is NOT a zero input: the DiffSinger inference path gives SP frames a non-zero predicted F0, the NSF source is excited by it, and the vocoder emits a tonal waveform. A detector false positive and a pipeline-generated signal must not be conflated.

hard_requirements.definition: Values along the forced_long_tail ladder (0/40/80/160 ms) must be non-decreasing (each step >= -reproducibility_bound) and the total span (last - first) must reach the minimum below.
Values recomputed in an independent OS process are identical.
Every measured value is finite (no NaN / inf) on every calibration stimulus.

fail_closed: If no candidate for an axis satisfies every hard requirement, that axis is frozen as UNAVAILABLE with the failing requirement recorded. Requirements are never loosened to obtain a survivor.

keys.why: response margin to a controlled PHYSICAL perturbation, not to labels
finer frame grid = lower quantisation floor

numeric_precision.rule: Round every numeric ranking key to 9 decimal places before comparing; equal rounded values fall through to the next key.
numeric_precision.why: Without it, ties are decided by float noise at the 1e-16 level, which is not a physical property and is not stable across BLAS / numpy builds.

amendments.what: Added ranking_among_survivors.numeric_precision (round to 9 decimals before comparing keys).
amendments.observed: The first B-1 run showed monotone_min_step values tying at 0.13333333333333341 / ...36 / ...30 for tail_f0_persistence, i.e. the winner was selected by a 5e-17 difference.
amendments.chosen_from: the magnitude of float noise, not from any candidate's outcome
amendments.not_changed: No candidate, stimulus, hard requirement, tolerance or ranking key was added, removed or reordered.

amendments.pr: STEP 6 amendment (User 裁定 2026-08-21 / (A) 採用)
amendments.what: Renamed hard requirement silence_zero -> zero_input_false_positive and redefined its stimulus as a synthetic bit-exact zero buffer. Tolerances are unchanged (ms_axes 0.0 / ratio_axes 0.01).
amendments.why: 旧刺激が要求の意味を実装していなかった。要求の意味は「測定器が無入力に対して 0 を返すか」であり、SP-only real render は無入力ではない（下記 observed）。
amendments.reason_is_not: 候補の成績ではない。どの候補が通るかを理由にしていない。1.0-rc2 の実測は歴史的成果物として保存し、書き換えていない。

observed_on_rr_silence.note: SP しか命令していないのに命令音高の調波が出る。経路 = SP -> duration -> pitch predictor が SP フレームにも非ゼロ F0 -> acoustic -> NSF source -> vocoder。

amendments.rr_silence_demoted_to: diagnostic observation (pipeline_silence_residual). pass/fail に使わない
amendments.not_changed: 候補空間 / window / hop / mel 設定 / ranking_among_survivors（キー名 silence_residual を含め byte 単位で不変）/ 他 5 要件と全許容値 / 校正条件 11 + 派生 2 のいずれも変更しない。
amendments.requires: この amendment を単独 commit/pin した後に、全候補を最初から再測定する

numerical_floor.ms_axes: hop duration in ms of the selected candidate
numerical_floor.ratio_axes: 1 / (number of analysis frames inside the tail window)

epsilon_derivation_for_b2.reproducibility_bound: max |delta| over in-process repeats and independent-process repeats of the selected candidate across every calibration stimulus
epsilon_derivation_for_b2.prohibition: Production labels ("ritsu is bad", "pjs is good") must not be consulted when setting epsilon.
